modelspec.data.MaskingPolicy.title: MaskingPolicy
modelspec.data.MaskingPolicy.description: The masked-language-modelling policy; of the selected tokens a fraction is replaced by the vocabulary's mask token, a fraction by a random token and the rest kept, 80/10/10 (epic:bert-from-scratch). The three fractions sum to 1, which ESS does not state here. Draws use the Philox key/counter derivation (DESIGN.md § 2.3) with stream tag 3, the next after the tags 0 to 2 of DESIGN.md § 2.3, keyed by the run seed and drawn anew at every step (coordinator decision D26, 2026-10-24, `.engineering/waves/bert-1.md`). Row n of the batch of step k, flattened to N = B × S rows, takes the block of counter [n, 3, id as u32, (id >> 32) as u32], where id is k for the Train split and k + 2^63 for the HeldOut split. The row is selected when its token is not one of the five special tokens and the uniform draw (w + 0.5) / 2^32 of word 0 is below selection_rate; a selected row becomes `[MASK]` when the uniform draw of word 1 is below mask_fraction, a random token when it is below mask_fraction + random_fraction, and keeps its token otherwise. The random token is 5 + ⌊w2 × (V − 5) / 2^32⌋ for word 2 w2 and vocabulary size V, so it is never a special token. The values are BERT's (Devlin, Chang, Lee, Toutanova 2018, § 3.1) — selection_rate 0.15, mask_fraction 0.8, random_fraction 0.1, keep_fraction 0.1 (coordinator decision D19, 2026-10-24, `.engineering/waves/bert-1.md`).
